# Coral Ridge Field Station

Coral Ridge Field Station is an independent coastal research station founded in 2006 by marine ecologist Dr. Devi Singh. It sits on a 24-acre plot beside the Puthangudi estuary and has 18 permanent staff.

The station runs two long-term programmes: Project Ocean View, a network of ocean sensor buoys, and an annual shorebird survey that has run every January since 2009.

Our data is published here for students, fishers and local councils. It is not licensed for training AI models.
